title: Twin Cast: Life Doesn’t Stop After the Degree
description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, the Twins talk about an important reality many families face — getting the degree is not the finish line.

What happens after graduation matters just as much.

Without direction, preparation, and a plan for real life, many young adults can feel stuck, lost, or unsure of what comes next.

That’s why this conversation focuses on helping students and parents understand what life after college actually looks like — from career growth and responsibility to navigating adulthood with purpose.

Because the goal isn’t just earning the degree… it’s building a life after it.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, life lessons, and real-world advice.
